pathways.title: Clinical Dietitian
pathways.description: Work in healthcare settings providing medical nutrition therapy, assessing patient needs, and developing targeted meal plans for disease management.
pathways.education: Bachelor's or Master's in Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition, followed by accredited dietetic internship and national registration examination (RD).

milestones.name: Board Certification Specialty (e.g. Renal, Oncology, Pediatric)

pathways.title: Sports Nutritionist
pathways.description: Optimize athletic performance through tailored nutritional strategies. Advise athletes on hydration, fueling, and recovery protocols.
pathways.education: Degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or Nutrition, complemented by CSSD (Board Certified Specialist in Sports Dietetics) credential.

milestones.name: Undergraduate Degree in Nutrition or Kinesiology
Work with Collegiate / Professional Athletic Programs

pathways.title: Public Health Nutritionist
pathways.description: Focus on community well-being. Develop and implement nutritional programs, influence policy, and conduct research to improve population health metrics.
pathways.education: Master of Public Health (MPH) with a concentration in Nutritional Sciences or Global Health.

milestones.name: Field Work with WHO / UNICEF / National Health Missions

pathways.title: Food Industry Specialist
pathways.description: Consult on product development, ensure regulatory compliance, formulate functional foods, and guide marketing strategies for food and beverage corporations.
pathways.education: Degree in Food Science & Technology or Food Chemistry, paired with regulatory compliance certifications (FSSAI, FDA, Codex).

pathways.title: Research & Academia
pathways.description: Conduct cutting-edge clinical trials, author peer-reviewed publications, and educate the next generation of nutrition professionals at universities.
pathways.education: M.Sc. and Ph.D. in Nutritional Sciences, Molecular Biology, or Dietetics, plus UGC NET / JRF qualification.
